card.text: The Blue Snowball Nebula is a planetary nebula about 1,740 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G106.5-17.6: distance 1,740 pc (1,648 to 1,842) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star
Wikipedia, "NGC 7662"
sources.quote: NGC 7662 is a planetary nebula located in the northern constellation Andromeda.

introduction.text: It has two shells, one inside the other, both stretched along an axis that points partly toward us; the outer one expands faster.

sources.label: Guerrero, Jaxon & Chu (2004), AJ 128, 1705: physical structure of planetary nebulae. II. NGC 7662
sources.locator: Sect. 3.2 and Table 1: two ellipsoidal shells, the major axis tilted 50° against the line of sight with its north-east end toward us; 35 to 53 km/s and 50 to 60 km/s

sources.label: Wikipedia, "NGC 7662"
sources.quote: It is known as the Blue Snowball Nebula, Snowball Nebula, and Caldwell 22.

optical.title: The Blue Snowball in visible light
optical.summary: Hubble's picture on the walls of the nebula's two shells, with the shape, tilt and speed its spectra give them.
